issues.area: Test harness (found while hunting; not an engine bug)
issues.problem: isIdleSilent ignores an applyAndFollow running in a caller's own task (applyTurnHeld, applyQueue, appliesInFlight). In PROBE-C23C-WALK2, 11 of the 24 even seeds hung past their 900 s time limit. The diagnostic variant (PROBE-C23C-WALK2-DIAG) re-ran 8 of those seeds. Where a seed stalled (102, 112, 116), the drive had returned 'idle' with applyTurnHeld true, applyQueue 29-52, and one store sleeper 0.25 s ahead (the commit window). After shutdown, the apply in flight waited on the manual clock for ever. One 1 s clock advance ended every apply, and all end checks then passed in 8/8 seeds (76 s). A live clock ends that window, so no production liveness defect is proven. But any test that applies from its own task and drives on isIdleSilent can leave work pending without noticing.
issues.fix: At a re-open: tests or probes that call applyAndFollow, or the availability/ensure paths, from their own tasks should drive until isIdleSilent && appliesInFlight == 0, or the harness could offer that predicate. No change now.
